AI agent monitoring platform Raindrop raised a $35 million Series A round led by CRV, co-founders Zubin Koticha and Ben Hylak tell Axios Pro exclusively.

**Why it matters:** With [AI safety](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/09/ai-doom-pdoom-kill-all-humans-anthropic) top of mind, no one wants an agent to go [rogue](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/openais-rogue-agents-probed-hugging-face-weaknesses-two-months-before-major-hack-2026-09-16/).
